blocks.text: Dear Harvest Partner, The final hours of prophecy are approaching making time the most important commodity this earth has. I believe the earth is now found wanting and weighed in the balance. Two large earthquakes occurred, one after the other. Haiti at 7.0 on the Richter scale, and Chile at 8.8. This shook and moved the planet as well as slowing down time a few milliseconds. As Brother Frisby wrote in past Scripts these major events would be occurring right before Christ’s return, as well as great signs in the heavens. That brings me to events about to happen. June 26, 2010 there will be an eclipse of the moon along with a grand square at that exact time. But that’s not all! Also on this exact date the last 7- year cycle ends and a transition period begins and completes the transition on March 11, 2011, and begins the next new 7-year cycle. Also on July 11, 2010 a total solar eclipse takes place. So we can see, time is on the move! – We are now moving into the 3-dimensional transition period. All electronic devices are preparing for 3-dimensional pictures. Brother Frisby spoke that this would occur just before the anti-Christ appears with his 3-dimensional mark. Now let’s let Brother Frisby bring this prophecy to you that he wrote a few years back. And now a quote from Neal Frisby. Prophecy – “Not since God created this planet has people been so fearful of the future. They see the dangers of environmental chaos, worldwide depression, famine, nuclear holocaust, and social crisis.” “Many students of the Word now begin to see this looming ahead. – As we know, the Scripts foretold that many of these events would take place years in advance!” – “The thing to watch and will be dangerous for the future is the ‘electronic’ age! They are entering what they call the 6th generation (revolutionary) computers. One such is called the super-triode.” “A certain type computer will work in three dimensions! – We read in Rev. 13:18 about a dimensional number 666 . . . In dimension this represents the number, the name and the mark of the beast! So it seems the laser and the electronic age is working towards this Scripture and verse 15.” – “Also the computer is in development now with the prospect of bringing forth artificial intelligence, seen as a form of artificial life in it!” – “Also man can now use similar type of technology – they call the electronic beacon implant. By putting a tiny device under the skin they will able to track an individual by satellite, no matter where he goes!” – “This would be devastating in the hands of a dictator. No more privacy left! The space age inventions reveal to us that we are near the return of the Lord!”

Mystery and Revelation – “We are entering the stage of the 3-fold manifestation. In the early 1900’s there was a Pentecostal outpouring! – Then we had a great former rain from 1946 onward! – And now the former and latter rain has come together, and surely will increase in power as we enter a climatic restoration and end.” – “This has led to the dramatic scenes shown in Rev. 10:1-7, wherein the 7 Thunders uttered their voices! Their secrets revealed to the elect only and the full power of the Lord will bring forth the resurrection and translation of His saints! – What a time of refreshing is moving in on us!” – The last chapter of Revelation, the words of Jesus was, “Behold, I come quickly!” – “We are to be expectant of these things daily. The Lord is definitely standing at the door because the end of all things is at hand!” (I Peter 4:7) “Some people cannot be awakened even when it is occurring all around them; they are asleep and are like this Scripture!” Jer. 8:7, “Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgement of the LORD!” – “So let us put on the whole armour of God, for we are living in perilous times and a day of deception! The key word is watch and pray!”

“Behold put ye on the full armor of My Word, and sharpen thy arrows of My spirit against the wiles of evil! Because Satan knoweth time is short and shall take away many in strong delusion! Stand ye straight in the Lord your God and He shall overcome you in blessings and give you His protection! Yea a new Age cometh, prophesy, prophesy the end is near!” Amen. (End quote.) – This should leave no doubt about the true Word of God, keeping the elect informed. Brother Frisby’s prophecies have certainly done this!

Wonderful news! We now have a web site in the Netherlands – www.NealFrisby.nl. This has been brought about by some wonderful partners that have endeavored for this to happen. I would like to give them thanks and the blessings of God for their effort. – This month I am releasing two Special Writings called “Prophecy – Line Upon Line” and “Apostasy – A Moment of Truth Arriving.” Also a wonderful DVD called “God Calculates!” (See offer below.) – Concerning our publications, we are purchasing newer printers to publish all of the new books and your help will truly be appreciated. God’s blessings will be with all of those who pray and support this effort. “The Lord gave the Word: Great was the company of those that published it.” (Ps. 68:11) Praise the Lord our God for His eternal love.
